row: locale capture, ready replay, one room attempt and Company AI session recovery parity

base.rule: additive minor; v1 through v1.2 bytes remain frozen

binding.ready_replay: same executor, incarnation, identity, room and profile returns the current ready view
binding.changed_input: conflict or denial with no mutation

room_attempt.identity: attemptId is stable for the membership incarnation
room_attempt.marker: the create-room marker contains the same attemptId
room_attempt.recovery: before creating, find a room with this exact marker; if found bind it instead of creating another

session.expired: same-session regenerate is admitted after recorded expiry
session.unknown_rotate: retain current session and retry; never move identity to attention
session.post_commit_attach_failure: retry performs rotate against the committed same session
